source:
[u][b]The Stepmother Oppai Spy Mama![/b][/u]
Race: Human
Code Name: Oboro
Libido and Lewdness Level: 3.9 / 5.0
Masturbation Frequency: Normal

Nagi’s mother, and the protagonist’s stepmother. Her boobs are U-cups, and Nagi inherited her breast size from her.

A descendant of the prestigious and well-known Azuma ninja bloodline. Shigure’s ancestors were a clan that continued operating behind the scenes throughout history. When she was younger, she married a ninja connected to the Azuma clan and gave birth to Nagi, but her husband died in an accident during a mission. Afterwards, she met the protagonist’s father, who belonged to a different ninja school, on the battlefield, and the two fell in love before becoming rogue ninjas together. They remarried and spent happy days together, but her husband once again died after killing an assassin sent by the Azuma clan at the cost of his own life. Since then, she has continued raising both Nagi and the protagonist on her own.

Perhaps because of her upbringing, she has a serious and strict personality, and can be somewhat inflexible. After breaking the seal on an item left behind by her late husband, she ended up being transported to another world together with her son and daughter. (She had opposed opening it, but the protagonist convinced her by saying: “What if it’s a love letter Dad wrote to you, Shigure-san?”) Under the condition that they would search for both a way to survive in this world and a method to return home, she accepted Headmistress Olivia’s request and became a special instructor at the spy academy. Her subject is the newly established “Ninjutsu,” and her codename is “Oboro,” the alias she used during her ninja days. Due to her personality, she was well-suited for teaching, and because she was also an elite kunoichi, she quickly became extremely popular among the students.

Her relationship with her daughter Nagi cannot exactly be called good, and the two often argue, forcing the protagonist to mediate between them. Endless pointless arguments continue daily between Shigure, who wants to return to their original world, and Nagi, who wishes to remain in this one. According to the protagonist, both mother and daughter suffer a dramatic drop in IQ whenever they fight.

Although she is strict toward her daughter Nagi, she is extremely soft on the protagonist, who is the child left behind by her late husband. The protagonist also holds back somewhat because she is his stepmother, but apparently she truly wishes he would rely on and cling to her much more. She often scolds him by saying: “Nagi is watching, so no.” However, Nagi suspiciously wonders if that means it would be fine as long as she were not watching.

Her hobbies are training, cooking Japanese food, and visiting hot springs. The things she dislikes are machines such as smartphones, foreign loanwords, and alcohol, since she becomes a violent drunk. She also has a habit of forcefully converting foreign words into Japanese.
